title: Mini Challenge — Visualize a Real Dataset

phase1.code:
# Mini Challenge: Visualize a Real Dataset

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

print("=== Mini Challenge: Create a Complete Visualization Dashboard ===\n")

# Create a realistic dataset
np.random.seed(42)
n = 500

data = pd.DataFrame({
    'Player_ID': range(1, n+1),
    'Level': np.random.normal(50, 20, n).clip(1, 100).astype(int),
    'Health': np.random.normal(100, 30, n).clip(20, 200).astype(int),
    'Mana': np.random.normal(80, 25, n).clip(0, 150).astype(int),
    'Attack': np.random.normal(30, 10, n).clip(5, 60).astype(int),
    'Defense': np.random.normal(20, 8, n).clip(1, 40).astype(int),
    'Speed': np.random.normal(15, 5, n).clip(1, 30).astype(int),
    'Gold': np.random.normal(500, 200, n).clip(0, 1500).astype(int),
    'Class': np.random.choice(['Warrior', 'Mage', 'Rogue', 'Archer', 'Paladin'], n),
    'Is_Active': np.random.choice([True, False], n, p=[0.7, 0.3])
})

print(f"Dataset shape: {data.shape}")
print(data.head())

print("\n=== Task 1: Class Distribution ===\n")

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(data=data, x='Class', palette='Set2')
plt.title('Class Distribution')
plt.xlabel('Class')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.show()

print("\n=== Task 2: Level Distribution by Class ===\n")

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.boxplot(data=data, x='Class', y='Level', palette='Set3')
plt.title('Level Distribution by Class')
plt.xlabel('Class')
plt.ylabel('Level')
plt.show()

print("\n=== Task 3: Correlation Heatmap ===\n")

# Select numeric columns for correlation
numeric_cols = ['Level', 'Health', 'Mana', 'Attack', 'Defense', 'Speed', 'Gold']
corr = data[numeric_cols].corr()

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.heatmap(corr, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', center=0, fmt='.2f', square=True)
plt.title('Feature Correlation Heatmap')
plt.show()

print("\n=== Task 4: Pair Plot ===\n")

# Select subset for clarity
sns.pairplot(data[['Level', 'Health', 'Attack', 'Defense', 'Class']],
             hue='Class', diag_kind='kde', corner=True)
plt.suptitle('Pair Plot of Key Features', y=1.02)
plt.show()

print("\n=== Task 5: Active vs Inactive Players ===\n")

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))

# Count of active/inactive
axes[0].pie(data['Is_Active'].value_counts(),
            labels=['Active', 'Inactive'],
            autopct='%1.1f%%',
            colors=['green', 'red'])
axes[0].set_title('Active vs Inactive Players')

# Level distribution by active status
sns.boxplot(data=data, x='Is_Active', y='Level', ax=axes[1])
axes[1].set_title('Level by Active Status')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Active?')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Level')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("\n=== Task 6: Stats by Class ===\n")

# Grouped bar chart of average stats
class_stats = data.groupby('Class')[['Level', 'Health', 'Attack']].mean()

class_stats.plot(kind='bar', figsize=(12, 6))
plt.title('Average Stats by Class')
plt.xlabel('Class')
plt.ylabel('Average Value')
plt.legend(title='Stat')
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()

print("\n=== Challenge Complete! ===\n")

print("You've created a complete data visualization dashboard!")
print("✅ Class distribution")
print("✅ Level distribution by class")
print("✅ Correlation heatmap")
print("✅ Pair plot")
print("✅ Active vs inactive comparison")
print("✅ Stats by class")
